About the Women-Led Cycling Wednesday Night Ride group ride

A Wednesday night group ride out of the Waldo neighborhood, led by women and open to everyone. Listed by BikeWalkKC's Women Bike KC program as one of the metro's inclusive ride groups. Meet point and time go up on Instagram each week.
